route: Contrat de travail visé (titre de séjour « salarié »)

permit.applies: The employer lodges the performer's contract at the Ministry of Employment's central registry for its visa, under the category 'agents de nationalité étrangère exerçant dans le champ Sportif et Artistique', with separate files for the first grant and the renewal.
permit.first: The Ministry of Employment's visa on the work contract (visa du contrat de travail).
permit.exemptNote: None: performers are not among the categories given an attestation of non-subjection (employers and managers, investment-law, hydrocarbons and mining staff, cooperation experts, Moroccans).
